name: C11_PAIR_PI_DISCOVERY_GATE_V1

target.object: For each ordered survivor pair (y,y') in R_C11, compute the four bits q_33,q_34,q_43,q_44.
target.bit_definition: q_{gamma,delta}(y,y')=1 iff the fixed descendant P' has an extension with y=gamma and y'=delta, gamma,delta in {3,4}.

central_question: Can all four Pi feasibility bits be computed in polynomial time from frozen graph/state structure, without invoking the original 4-precoloring extension problem as an oracle?
anti_cheat: The operation 'precolor y,y' and ask whether it extends' is the bit definition, not a polynomial discovery algorithm.
Adding y,y' to a seed/fixed set is not by itself a terminal algorithm.
Finite empirical success is not D1.
The <=16 semantic mask bound alone does not establish graph-discoverability.
A call to general P7-free 4-coloring/precoloring extension is forbidden.
No hidden use of an extension witness c is allowed in discovery.

steps: Fix y=gamma and y'=delta by an exact polynomial transformation whose satisfiability is equivalent to the bit q_{gamma,delta}.
Apply only already frozen/source-faithful propagation and Lemma-7/Lemma-10-compatible normalization steps; record exact semantics and reconstruction.
Let H be the remaining undecided induced graph after fixed vertices are represented in lists.
Decompose H into connected components C.
For every C, find a color c_C in [4] absent from every list in C, equivalently union_{v in C} L(v) is a subset of [4]\{c_C}.
Rename the three allowed colors if needed and solve the resulting List-3-Coloring instance on induced P7-free C.
The fixed assignment is feasible iff every component is list-colorable; reconstruct an extension in polynomial time.

list3_terminal_authority.paper_II_use: Lemma 6 applies Theorem 2 to a precoloring-extension subproblem using only three colors on an induced subgraph.
list3_terminal_authority.cited_result: Bonomo et al., Three-Coloring and List Three-Coloring of Graphs Without Induced Paths on Seven Vertices, Combinatorica 38(4):779-801 (2018), DOI 10.1007/s00493-017-3553-8.
list3_terminal_authority.authority_statement: List 3-Coloring with lists contained in a three-color palette is polynomial-time solvable on P7-free graphs.
list3_terminal_authority.hereditary_condition: Every connected component of an induced subgraph of a P7-free graph is P7-free.

route_success_obligations: Exact equivalence between q_{gamma,delta} and the transformed fixed-pair instance.
All propagation/normalization steps polynomial and semantics-preserving.
Every remaining undecided component has a certified globally missing color.
All external fixed-neighbor effects are fully encoded in the component lists.
No edges/interactions remain between distinct undecided components.
List-3 calls are on induced P7-free components.
Reconstruction of a full extension is polynomial.
Total time for one bit is polynomial; all four bits per pair remain polynomial.
Computing masks for all at most n^2 structural survivor pairs remains within the frozen polynomial budget.

obstruction_receipt_for_three_color_rout.label: NO_GLOBAL_MISSING_COLOR
required_fields: frozen input and exact survivor pair
complete current list assignment on C
proof that C is a remaining undecided connected component
proof no frozen propagation rule removes another color before the proposed List-3 terminal
obstruction_receipt_for_three_color_rout.interpretation: This refutes only the direct componentwise missing-color/List-3 route at that state. It does not prove q hard to compute or P3 false.

D1_PI_POLY_DISCOVERABLE.condition: A proof-carrying polynomial algorithm computes all four bits for every authoritative-core C11 survivor pair.
consequences: Equivalence by equal Pi masks becomes a polynomially discoverable exact semantic quotient with <=16 classes.
Each class summary is exactly four bits and independent of class multiplicity.
If |R_C11|>16, at least two distinct pairs are genuinely merged by pigeonhole; if |R_C11|<=16, the family is already constant-size at this semantic level.
The mapping of at most n^2 pairs to 4-bit masks plus <=16 summaries is polynomial-size.

D2_PARTIAL_PI_DISCOVERY.condition: At least one nontrivial subset of assignments/pairs is solved by a proved polynomial terminal route, while at least one exact frozen route obstruction is returned.
required_output: which q bits/routes are polynomially certified
P3 remains NOT_ESTABLISHED unless all four bits for all pairs are covered

D3_PI_DISCOVERY_UNRESOLVED.condition: No universal polynomial computation of all four bits is established and no stronger conclusion is justified.

next_action: Separate execution authorization required. First audit PAIR_FIXED_THREE_COLOR_COLLAPSE exactly; do not search for repair.
